predictions.rationale: Central bootstrap for the Identity micro-service; configures IdentityServer4, authentication schemes, token issuance, and middleware protecting all services.
Defines IdentityServer clients, resources, scopes, and signing credentials—core to issuing and validating access tokens.
Implements login, logout, registration, and account-management endpoints directly supporting user authentication flows.
Service that authenticates users against the EF data store and works with IdentityServer to issue tokens.
Supplies user claims and profile data to IdentityServer when generating JWT/access tokens.
Entity Framework context holding user accounts, roles, and related identity data leveraged during authentication.
Represents the user entity with additional properties used throughout registration, login, and token generation.
Loads X509 certificates used by IdentityServer to sign issued JWT tokens, a critical part of secure token issuance.
Handles user consent screens during authentication flows, directly tied to token issuance and scopes.
Entry point that builds and runs the Identity service host, enabling the authentication and token infrastructure.
